أبو الحسين محمد بن علي الشجاعي
أبو عبد الله محمد بن إبراهيم
عاصم بن عمر بن علي بن مقدام أبو يونس

notes: «وبهذا الإسناد» opens the report: prev1 to prev5 open with the same phrase and write no chain; prev6 (report 90) is the nearest written chain, so its first three names are taken over as inherited; the text writes محمد بن عثمان itself, which is therefore read as this text's own link and not repeated
prev6's محمد بن عثمان بن علان is not identified with this text's محمد بن عثمان (rule 9)
«حدثني أبي» is a bare kin term (relation); the Companion Jabir b. Samura is the last link, with the Prophet's words after him
